stories.title: Trescothick masterclass eases Somerset to victory
stories.subTitle: Somerset v Glamorgan, Friends Life t20, Taunton
stories.seoTitle: Somerset v Glamorgan: Trescothick masterclass eases Somerset to victory
stories.summary: Marcus Trescothick produced another T20 master class as Somerset moved to the top of the Friends Life South Group with a seven-wicket victory over Glamorgan at Taunton
